decision: Nominal reference candidate is promising; preserve for a separately approved matched policy-training/evaluation comparison. No policy substitution or physical-readiness approval.

assessment.decision: Nominal reference candidate is promising; preserve for a separately approved matched policy-training/evaluation comparison. No policy substitution or physical-readiness approval.
assessment.parity: Instrumented existing replay root_pos/root_quat/joint_pos array-identical. Generated original and shipped NPZ all pose/quaternion/jointvel arrays bit-identical; body linear/angular velocity absmax differences 3.64e-12/1.46e-11. Therefore observed yaw correction is not an absolute/default-offset reconstruction bug.
remaining_limits: Posthoc tradeoff: peak planar root excursion increases from 6.02cm to 7.25cm despite tiny final displacement; this was not a predeclared screen and the candidate is not uniformly improved.
Candidate still ends 0.4646rad away from its initial pose at the worst joint; it is not seamless repeatable or permission to remove measured-joint initialization.
Both exporter runs use ground contacts on lower-leg hulls, not exclusively foot spheres; no new loaded geometry does not establish equal support stability.
Soft simulated joint limit penetration remains: candidate0.00636rad vs original0.01509rad. Zero raw-target limit violations does not imply zero physical limit risk.
No learned controller has been trained or evaluated on the changed reference. Original policy checkpoint must not be silently paired with new reference.
One nominal symmetric model/floor only. Motor mismatch, IMU bias, tracking generalization and actual floor slip remain physical/evaluation concerns.
Walking return has separate measured opposite-sign yaw. This reference repair does not resolve or isolate that controller behavior.
assessment.why_not_yaw_only: Subtracting time-varying root yaw alone leaves asymmetric joint targets and changes implied world stance-foot trajectories. That postprocessed motion is not shown dynamically consistent. Mirror-averaging targets and replaying the unchanged dynamics produces mutually consistent simulated body/joint/contact trajectories under this one condition.
next_bounded_work_if_authorized: Freeze original/current policy as comparator and train a candidate with identical training recipe and new exact motion identity.

Evaluate original and candidate under matched native policy observations/action limits/history with the existing full-hull/return handoff harness; include yaw, tracking, limits, contacts and return settling.
Do not promote solely on training reward or this reference replay; retain supervised physical comparison after simulation evidence.
